		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = hd_hb_d_huo_xing } }

		scope:hd_hb_person ?= {
			set_global_variable = { name = hd_hb_d_huo_xing value = yes }
		}
		hd_hb_clear_effect = yes
	}
}
